           'receipt': E / 'bd1/out/positive/1/receipts/1-kicad-route-builtin/receipt.json',
           'mismatch_capture': E / 'bd1/preflight.json',

QUALIFIERS = [
    'The RC fixture was ALREADY CONNECTED. baseline_unconnected_total=0 and unconnected_total=0; new_tracks, new_vias '

    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rel(path):

    raise SystemExit(f'{rel(OUT)} exists; not overwritten')

    'schema': 'agent-ee.k91-native-positive/amended-evaluation/1',
    'item': 'AGENTEE-442',
    'authority': ('agent-521 ruling f14c71ec (coordinator decision relayed by agent-449, not owner text); '
                  'delta review: "Verdict: READY — classifier-contract implementation at git object '
                  'fd87b0c9fd7f851acde04c78f162cbb183025986"'),
    'agent_ee_head': subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                    check=True).stdout.strip(),
    'generator': {'path': 'build/a1_evaluate.py (not committed; source below)', 'sha256': sha(__file__),
                  'source': Path(__file__).read_text()},
    'classifiers': {
        'original': {'id': v2.CLASSIFIER_V2, 'file': 'scripts/k91_classify.py', 'sha256': sha(ROOT / 'scripts/k91_classify.py'),
                     'preserved_copy': 'evidence/k91-native-positive-c/amend-a1/original-classifier/k91_classify.py',
                     'preserved_copy_sha256': sha(E / 'amend-a1/original-classifier/k91_classify.py')},
        'amended': {'id': a1.CLASSIFIER_V2A1, 'amendment': a1.AMENDMENT, 'file': 'scripts/k91_classify_a1.py',
                    'sha256': sha(ROOT / 'scripts/k91_classify_a1.py')}},
    'linkage': {name: {'path': rel(path), 'sha256': sha(path)} for name, path in SOURCES.items()},
    'receipt_id': receipt['receipt_id'],
    'mismatch_capture': {'field': 'mismatch_M', 'commit': captured.get('commit'),
                         'extension_sha256': captured.get('extension_sha256')},
    'identities': identities,
    'original_classification': {
        'sealed_verdict': manifest['verdict'], 'recomputed_equals_sealed': original == manifest['verdict'],
        'sealed_classifier': manifest['classifier'], 'sealed_classifier_sha256': manifest['classifier_sha256'],
        'qualified': manifest['qualified'], 'stdout_equals_sealed_verdict':
            json.loads(SOURCES['original_stdout'].read_text()) == manifest['verdict'], 'exit': exit_lines},
    'amended_verdict': amended,
    'qualified': False,
    'scope_qualifiers_r1_agent_510_verbatim': QUALIFIERS,
    'not_claimed': ['routing work or algorithmic improvement', 'production release or qualification', 'target benefit',
                    'same-commit tamper behavior', 'K96 release', 'a new native positive or regrade'],
}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'record': rel(OUT), 'sha256': sha(OUT), 'amended': {k: amended[k] for k in (
    'classifier', 'positive_accepted', 'controls', 'controls_refused', 'not_refused_because')}}, ensure_ascii=False))
